caption: Category Distribution of dataset
model_annotation: The pie chart illustrates the category distribution of a dataset, divided into six distinct segments, each representing a different category with its corresponding percentage and absolute count. The largest segment, colored salmon pink, represents "chat" at 41.2% (546,526 instances), occupying more than a third of the chart. The second largest segment, in blue, is "math" at 21.9% (290,496). Following that, the green segment labeled "tooluse" accounts for 11.6% (154,358). The orange segment for "multi turn chat" makes up 9.3% (123,615), while the light purple "code" segment represents 9.0% (119,563). The smallest segment, in pink, is "instruction follow" at 6.9% (91,460). Each slice is labeled directly on the chart with its category name and percentage, and a legend on the left side provides the color key along with the exact counts for each category. The segments are arranged in a clockwise order starting from the top-right, with the largest slice ("chat") positioned on the left side of the chart.
